prompt: If one wanted to create a data quality application that runs on data stored in HDFS, what would be a good way to approach this? Specifically, assuming the user has defined data quality rules, what would be a good way to evaluate them (specifically in terms of performance)?
response: To create a data quality application for HDFS, you can use a simple rule-based system where rules are defined based on performance. For example, you could set up rules that prioritize data based on its access frequency or performance. This approach allows for easy modification of rules as performance requirements change.
